event.label: Poland’s additional tank pledge
event.description: Four reports discuss Poland’s January 27 pledge of 60 additional tanks plus 14 Leopards. They disagree about how many of the 60 are PT-91s. The graph compares reported promises, not completed deliveries.

topics.label: How many additional tanks?
topics.scope_note: The 60-tank pledge is separate from the previously announced 14 Leopards; a pledge is not a confirmed delivery.

topics.label: How many are PT-91 models?
topics.scope_note: Sixty tanks in total and sixty PT-91 tanks are different propositions. Red records incompatible model counts for the reported pledge, without choosing the correct figure.

topics.label: What about the 14 Leopards?
topics.scope_note: These are additional to the 60-tank package and were pledged earlier; the articles do not say all tanks have already arrived.

topics.label: Should aid continue?
topics.scope_note: Quoted support belongs to the named official, not automatically to the reporting outlet.

topics.label: How quickly could they help?
topics.scope_note: An assessment of familiar Polish tanks is different from delivery forecasts for new Western models.

method.country_note: Outlet countries describe origin. Claimant countries describe an office, organization or stated residence, not assumed citizenship.
method.claim_type_note: A fact claim is a checkable statement, not a fact verified by this graph. Opinions, predictions, legal positions and promises are marked separately.
method.edge_note: Green arrows point from a supporting claim to the claim receiving support. Grey comparisons have no assigned direction. Solid red arrows point from a source claim to a target claim it is proposed to contradict. Red direction follows the analyst-assigned comparison order. Every proposed conflict retains its reasoning and scope limits for human review.
method.attention_note: Attention is a qualitative reading of the saved article, with paragraph locators; it is not a measured share of words.
method.endorsement_note: A quoted speaker’s view is separate from the article narrator’s view. No outlet-wide position is inferred from one article.
method.cleaning_note: Uses saved recovered text. Kyiv Independent later Most Popular / News Feed material is excluded; original paragraph numbers retained. FT wrapped lines are joined into logical paragraphs.

within_article_relations.note: P2 quotes Yermak saying 60 PT-91s; P5 quotes Morawiecki saying 30 PT-91s within 60 total tanks. Both sections remain separate. The graph does not choose the accurate number.
